title: Skywalk and shared-cofactor mechanism addendum
description: Each mechanism needs its own source preconditions. These catalog rules remain blocked until a constructor and both stage mappings exist.

definitions.retained product: A temporary Boolean carry product owned by one producer and one consumer.
definitions.rail: A signed arithmetic workspace whose width affects overflow and history.

rules.title: Share a retained carry product
rules.description: The Skywalk history encoder can consume a carry product retained by arithmetic. The inverse encoder repairs its deferred phase and returns the product.

mechanism.match: An arithmetic carry product with a source-defined history consumer.
mechanism.replace: A shared retained product instead of a recomputed product.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Measure Q and T; no fixed improvement is assumed.

rules.title: Add signed rail padding
rules.description: Extra signed rail bits can reduce overflow exceptions. A new rail geometry invalidates source-indexed cell and terminal assumptions.

mechanism.match: A source rail with inherited width.
mechanism.replace: The padded rail and its matching inverse history.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Measure Q and T; no fixed improvement is assumed.

rules.title: Add walk groups
rules.description: An extra source group adds five walk ticks. More ticks can improve reliability at a measured gate cost.

mechanism.replace: The inherited count plus five ticks per extra group.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Measure Q and T; no fixed improvement is assumed.

rules.title: Carry cofactors in a shared frame
rules.description: The COF variant places related cofactor values in a shared arithmetic frame. Every update must retain the declared relation and usable cleanup values.

mechanism.match: Source-owned cofactor registers and their update relation.
mechanism.replace: A source-backed shared-frame update with its inverse.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Measure Q and T; no fixed improvement is assumed.

notes: This rule records the supplied source-map concept. It does not supply a COF constructor or a performance claim.
